items.title: DAD TV Video Streaming Solution
items.description: A full-stack broadcasting and media-management platform developed for the Department of Agrarian Development, combining video uploads, live channel operations, multilingual news tickers, adaptive HLS delivery, stream monitoring, and automatic recovery.

items.title: AI Stack VM - Private Local RAG System
items.description: A self-hosted AI platform for running local large language models and retrieval-augmented generation over private engineering documents and source-code repositories, with authentication, rate limiting, and flexible Linux or OpenShift deployment.

details.overview: A private, self-hosted AI platform designed to run local language models and retrieval-augmented generation over sensitive engineering documents and source-code repositories without sending data to external AI services.
highlights: Retrieval across engineering documents and source repositories
Portable Linux and OpenShift deployment with Podman

architecture.deployment: Podman containers deployed on Linux or OpenShift

items.title: Real-Time Voice Control System
items.description: A modern AI-powered voice control system that lets users control a computer, browser, and media players using natural voice commands, powered by OpenAI Whisper and Silero VAD.

items.title: Service Advertising Mobile App
items.description: A Flutter mobile application with Firebase backend that connects customers with service providers. Customers can find, view, bookmark, chat with, and rate service providers.

items.title: AGROW - Smart Agriculture IoT Solution
items.description: AGROW bridges modern technology with agriculture, enabling farmers to monitor soil conditions in real time and receive intelligent fertilizer recommendations through IoT sensors.

items.title: PomeScan - Offline Pomegranate Quality Monitoring
items.description: An offline Edge AI system for detecting pomegranate ripeness and classifying common fruit diseases directly on a smartphone. The project combines a Flutter mobile application, YOLO-based computer vision models, TensorFlow Lite deployment, and a custom desktop suite for image preprocessing, dataset annotation, model training, validation, and benchmarking.

items.title: Mail Management System
items.description: A secure document-routing and approval platform for creating, distributing, tracking, and processing official correspondence across departments, with granular permissions, audit trails, PDF handling, dashboards, and search.

items.title: FarmerNet Web Platform
items.description: An agricultural information-management platform supporting farmer registration, land and cultivation records, damage reporting, harvesting records, and officer-side administrative workflows for the Department of Agrarian Development.

items.title: Air Quality Display and Management Web Application
items.description: An interactive web application for real-time air quality monitoring in Colombo. Users can view detailed air quality information while administrators manage sensor data and user access.
